name: permission-request
description: Fleet permission-request gate. Agents file a request ONLY for critical work (costs money, or needs access beyond what the agent already has). No form, no command: the command runs only after Frisky marks it Approve.
author: FriskyDevelopments

interface.shortDescription: Approval gate for critical agent actions
interface.longDescription: Defines the rule and the form agents use to ask Frisky for approval before any action that costs money or needs new access. Everything else runs without a form. Source definition lives in form.json and FORM.md; no live Tally form exists yet.
